card.name: Difficulty telling drug effects from disease
card.fires_on: Words in sentences saying it is hard or not possible to tell whether an event is caused by the drug or by the underlying condition. Fires on the verb or linking word just before 'determine', 'distinguish' or 'differentiate', or partway through that phrase.

modes.label: Hedge before 'not'
modes.description: A modal or verb after 'it' that leads into a statement that causality is not established.
modes.example: Other symptoms, such as anxiety and insomnia, were frequently seen during discontinuation, but it<< could>> not

modes.label: Differentiate or determine phrase
modes.description: Words inside 'difficult to differentiate/determine' clauses about drug versus disease cause.
modes.example: In therapy, it has been difficult to<< differentiate>> side effects due to the drug from those

modes.label: Confounder reasoning
modes.description: Punctuation or auxiliaries in clauses that cite confounders and then question the drug's role.

card.writes: It promotes words like 'distinguishing', 'attributable' and 'attributed', pushing the text toward separating causes.
card.plain: It marks sentences saying it is hard to tell whether a drug or the disease caused a finding.
